welcome.title: Welcome to MFA Setup
welcome.info_text:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds an extra layer of security to your account.

With MFA enabled, you'll need to provide a second form of verification
(in addition to your password) when logging in.

This helps protect your account even if your password is compromised.

You can choose from several authentication methods:
- Authenticator App (TOTP) - Most secure, recommended
- SMS Text Message - Codes sent to your phone
- Email - Codes sent to your email address

Click 'Get Started' to begin the setup process.

method_selection.title: Choose Authentication Methods
method_selection.subtitle: Select at least one method. You can enable multiple methods for backup.

totp.label: Authenticator App (TOTP)
totp.description:
Use apps like Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator.
This is the most secure method and works offline.

sms.label: SMS Text Message
sms.description:
Receive verification codes via text message.
Requires a valid mobile phone number.

email.label: Email Verification
email.description:
Receive verification codes via email.
Good as a backup method.

totp_setup.title: Set Up Authenticator App
totp_setup.instructions:
1. Download an authenticator app if you haven't already
   (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator)
2. Scan the QR code below with your app
3. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app

If you lose access to your authentication methods, you can use these
codes to regain access to your account. Each code can only be used once.
